events.title: US Permanent Hormuz Closure — Targeting Iran Shadow Fleet to China
events.description: Trump announced permanent closure of Strait of Hormuz to ALL shipping including Iran's shadow fleet tankers to China. Prior to this, the 6 daily transits were almost entirely Iranian shadow fleet exporting crude to China. This is the first direct US action threatening China's energy supply chain and could trigger a US-China naval confrontation.
asset_impact: Oil spike (Brent likely $120+) — zero transit means zero Middle East crude
China equities sell-off (energy supply chain threatened)
Defence stocks rally (EUAD, LMT, RTX — escalation premium)

events.title: US-Israel War with Iran
events.description: Major escalation with US-Israeli bombing campaigns targeting Iranian leadership, military, and nuclear assets. Iran blocking Strait of Hormuz (20% of global oil transit). New Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei vowing continued strikes on US bases.

events.title: Taiwan Semiconductor Tensions
events.description: Heightened China-Taiwan tensions around semiconductor supply chains. TSMC produces 92% of advanced chips globally, creating critical vulnerability for tech, cloud, and AI industries as geopolitical risks intensify.

events.title: European Political Instability
events.description: France facing government collapse under PM Bayrou amid budget crisis. Multiple EU elections in 2026 including Hungary (Orbán challenge), creating uncertainty over fiscal policy and EU unity.

events.title: Fed Policy Paralysis
events.description: Federal Reserve holds rates at 3.5-3.75% amid conflicting signals. Inflation rising to 2.7% (above 2% target), energy shock uncertainty, Powell's term ending in May, and Trump pressure creating policy uncertainty.

events.title: Persistent Ukraine War Effects
events.description: Ongoing disruptions to grain and energy exports from Russia-Ukraine conflict. Wheat and fertilizer prices elevated, affecting global food security and maintaining inflationary pressures in agricultural commodities.

overall_summary: March 2026 presents a perfect storm of stagflationary pressures with the Iran conflict driving oil prices up 40%+ while supply chain vulnerabilities from Taiwan and persistent Ukraine war effects maintain cost-push inflation. Simultaneously, geopolitical uncertainty and rising energy costs are dampening growth expectations, creating the classic stagflation dynamic of rising prices amid slowing growth.
